description: This file defines interfaces and implementations for reading and writing entities in JSON and XML formats within the go-restful package, including registration and lookup mechanisms for MIME types.

classes.name: entityXMLAccess
classes.description: Implements EntityReaderWriter for XML encoding and decoding, managing Content-Type header.

classes.name: entityJSONAccess
classes.description: Implements EntityReaderWriter for JSON encoding and decoding, managing Content-Type header.

methods.name: RegisterEntityAccessor
methods.description: Registers or overrides the EntityReaderWriter for a specific MIME type.

methods.name: NewEntityAccessorJSON
methods.description: Creates a new EntityReaderWriter for JSON content with specified content type.

methods.name: NewEntityAccessorXML
methods.description: Creates a new EntityReaderWriter for XML content with specified content type.

methods.name: accessorAt
methods.description: Retrieves the registered EntityReaderWriter for a given MIME type, with fallback to substring matching.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Unmarshalls data from request body into provided interface, for both XML and JSON implementations.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Marshalls data to response in either XML or JSON format, setting headers and handling pretty print.
